title: Retractable hooks and garment rod Wall Mount 2-1/2-Inch Traditional Brass Retractable Wall Hook | 15 lb | Allied Brass
description:
Create convenient, space-saving hanging in the bath or hallway with this wall mount retractable hook. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2 inches of hanging space, then pushes back in to stay out of the way—ideal for traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures.

Highlights:
- Retractable wall hook / retractable garment hook design: extends for use and retracts when not needed
- Wall mount installation saves floor space
- Supports up to 15 lb
- Brass construction with traditional styling
- Tip can be swapped: remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with your own cabinet knob
- Fits standard interior walls; mounting hardware included

Specs:
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Style: Traditional
- Hanging space: 2-1/2 in
- Size: 3.75 in W x 2 in H x 2 in L; projection 1 in
- Product weight: 1 lb
- Hardware: 6/32 toggles

Installation note:
- Drill a 3/4-inch diameter hole through drywall plus 3 small holes around.

Finish options:
- Available in 28 designer finishes, including statement colors such as antique pewter, lavender, sea foam green, autumn sparkle, and fire engine red.

_previous.title: Traditional Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
